coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Karnataka Domestic Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Bill 2025 (draft 15 Oct 2025) would make employers register on a state portal within a month of hiring, renew every 3 years, written agreements. No source found confirming passage, notification or a live portal in 2026 (two searches). No other state law found. Unverified, watch item.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No central scrap-dealer register. Tamil Nadu has a police licence for scrap merchants and second-hand dealers (annual). Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 cover dealers/collectors, and CPCB circular requires GST e-invoices on the EPR portal for recovered battery metal sales from 1 Jul 2026, but this hits recyclers, not kabadis. Nothing strong beyond weak candidate C07.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Karnataka Pawnbrokers Act 1961 amended 2025 (Act 18 of 2025); Tamil Nadu 1985 Act licenses scrap and second-hand dealers via police. Other states not confirmed; no online portal found. Used-vehicle dealers already covered by K07. Weak candidate C07.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: BIS hallmarking mandatory in 380 districts from 2 Mar 2026; BIS revised jeweller registration guideline 2 Jul 2026 (HUID transfer/update); jewellers are PMLA reporting entities for cash transactions of Rs 10 lakh or more (FIU-IND registration, CTR). Crowded by jewellery ERPs (not checked). Weak candidate C06.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: MoRTH draft RVSF Amendment Rules 2026 (17 Jun 2026): broader ELV definition, new Form 5 audit with geo-tagged photo evidence and annual return. Relates to RVSF operators (capital-intensive, few). Nothing for small dismantlers. Related K07 for used-vehicle dealers. Candidate C08 weak.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: DAHD compilation (May 2026) of Regulation of Livestock Market Rules: District Animal Market Monitoring Committee registration, holding capacity limits, traders must follow transport rules. Mostly state/committee level, no register software or recurring filing found. Nothing actionable.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Meat shops need FSSAI registration plus a separate municipal meat-shop licence; sources only commercial blogs; claimed FSSAI turnover slab change from 1 Apr 2026 and perpetual registration are unverified. No recurring return found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Madhukranti portal (National Bee Board) registration appears voluntary but gates NBHM subsidies; a 2021 Karnataka mandate for >10 hives existed. Beekeeping itself needs no FSSAI licence. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary drug retail licence via state drug controllers; antibiotics are Schedule H/H1 and need a registered vet prescription (DAHD answer); March 2026 CDSCO zonal delegation concerns manufacture only. No retail antibiotic sale register mandate found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: CGWA NOC portal plus state groundwater authorities (Karnataka KGWA registers drilling agencies and existing borewells; Telangana WALTA 2023 rules; Mumbai MGSDA/BMC registration). No primary 2026 rig-registration notification found. Candidate C09 weak/unverified (commercial borewell users, NOC conditions, meter returns); heavily state-variable.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Desludger licensing is state/ULB level (Tamil Nadu Urban Local Bodies Act s.179-B; Tamil Nadu 2025 bill extends to panchayats). Draft Liquid Waste Management Rules 2024 unconfirmed final. NAMASTE scheme extension to 2030-31 proposed (unconfirmed). No recurring filing or software gap confirmed. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Strong: new or amended state lift laws 2024-2026: Andhra Pradesh Lifts and Escalators Bill 2025 (existing lift owners must apply for a licence within 12 months of commencement), Telangana draft cabinet-cleared (annual inspections, recognised maintenance agencies), Tamil Nadu amendment Act 2025, Himachal Pradesh Lifts (Amendment) Bill 2026, Bihar 2024, UP Lifts and Escalators Act 2024, Maharashtra amendment Bill 2026 (only officer/definition changes). Candidate C01. Boilers and pressure equipment not searched.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Jal Jeevan Mission puts FTK water-quality surveillance on gram panchayats/VWSCs (FTKs available in only 27.2 percent of villages per Feb 2026 analysis); the state portal is the reporting system. Packaged-water units: BIS mandatory cert withdrawn Oct 2024, FSSAI compulsory testing scheme from 1 Jan 2026 (monthly NABL testing, per commercial source). Candidate C04. Water tankers and small supply schemes not found.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: No separate search spent; core duty already covered by K06 (agri-input shop monthly return autopilot). Nothing new beyond K06 can be asserted.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Contract labour now under OSH Code (in force 21 Nov 2025, central rules 8 May 2026; applies from 50 contract workers, 5-year licence, Shram Suvidha) - overlaps K14 (rejected as crowded). Overseas recruiting agents under Emigration Act 1983: registration Rs 25,000 fee, 5 yr certificate (MEA; Casemine says 10 yrs, conflict), monthly Form IV return by the 10th, ad copies to Protector of Emigrants, service charge cap. Candidate C03. Haryana 2026 travel-agent bill (Bill 3 of 2026) harmonises with Emigration Act.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No cemetery/funeral licensing regime found in results. Only waqf (many graveyards are waqf property): UMEED portal registration of waqf properties by mutawallis; SC refused general extension Dec 2025; state-wise tribunal extensions (UP to 5 Jun 2026, Telangana to 31 Mar 2026, J&K to 31 Jan 2026); 13,000+ UP establishments pending in June 2026. Candidate C05 weak.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: FCRA FC-4 by 31 Dec yearly (CA-certified, nil return required); 12A/80G Form 10AB renewal, CBDT Circular 06/2026 condoned late filings 1 Oct 2025 to 31 Mar 2026, decisions expected by 31 Dec 2026; Darpan. Heavily served by CA/NGO consultants. Candidate C02. Halal/kosher supervision not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Maharashtra Motor Vehicles (School Bus Regulation) (First Amendment) Rules 2026 gazetted 16 Jul 2026: VLTD with panic button, CCTV with 30-day retention, fire alarm, seat belts, parent app, digital attendance, staff verification/medical records, fare band +-10 percent, three months to comply; fitness renewal tied to working CCTV in Pune. Candidate C10. Aggregator guidelines 2025 (MoRTH) bind aggregators not owners; Maharashtra aggregator registration deadline 1 Sep 2026; Rajasthan draft aggregator rules (25+ vehicles). Small trucking not searched.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Street vendors: Town Vending Committee surveys and certificates of vending, Delhi HC (2026) ordered 23 TVCs by 21 Jul 2026; municipal-driven, nothing recurring for vendors beyond renewal. Money changers: FEM (Authorised Persons) Regulations 2026 (in force 6 May 2026), new FFMC licences halted, franchisees to move to Forex Correspondent framework within two years, FFMCs file LRS daily return (R010) on CIMS from 1 Jan 2026 incl. nil returns, quarterly franchisee lists, FLM-8 changes (A.P. DIR 17 of 24 Jun 2026). Candidate C11. FXPlus and Money Soft already sell FFMC back-office software.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Creches/daycare: no central licence; MWCD national minimum standards for creches Jan 2024 are advisory; Karnataka proposing mandatory portal registration after 2026 abuse reports (no final notification found); Punjab playschool registration announced. Driving schools already rejected K17. Tattoo studios and hunting outfitters: nothing found/not applicable (hunting not applicable in India). Small food producers: only FSSAI basic registration, covered in C04 for packaged water. Candidate C12 weak.
